name: Split AC units
tagline: Quiet, efficient cooling for individual rooms
description: A popular choice for homes and small offices, offering efficient cooling with a separate indoor and outdoor unit.
long_description: The indoor unit sits high on the wall and handles airflow, while the compressor and condenser stay outside. Keeping the noisy parts outdoors makes a split AC quiet inside. Inverter models adjust compressor speed to the room load, which cuts power use during long running hours in Hyderabad summers.
features: Quiet indoor operation with the compressor outside
Inverter and fixed-speed options to suit budget and usage
Neat wall-mounted indoor unit with simple remote control
Easy to service, with spares widely available

specs.label: Installation
specs.value: Wall-mounted indoor unit + outdoor unit on bracket or stand

variants.suits: Rooms up to about 120 sq ft

considerations: Top-floor, west-facing or glass-heavy rooms usually need the next capacity up
Choose inverter models if the AC runs more than 6 – 8 hours a day
Keep the outdoor unit in a shaded, ventilated spot for better efficiency
Copper piping runs over the standard length are charged extra

faqs.question: Inverter or non-inverter?
faqs.answer: For daily use of several hours, an inverter split pays back through lower power bills. For occasional use, a fixed-speed model keeps the upfront cost down.

faqs.question: What is included in installation?
faqs.answer: Mounting both units, standard copper piping, drain pipe, electrical connection, vacuuming and a cooling test. We'll confirm any extra piping or stand cost before work starts.
